description: Looks for a security.txt file (RFC 9116) at https://<domain>/.well-known/security.txt and then /security.txt, and reports whether one is published, its Contact, Expires, Policy and other fields, and whether it has expired. Redirects are reported but not followed. Refuses IP addresses, ports other than 80 and 443, and any host that resolves to a private, loopback, link-local, carrier-grade NAT or cloud metadata address.

domain.description: Domain to check, such as example.com. A full URL is also accepted; only its host name is used.

name: check_security_txt

status.description: HTTP status, or 0 when the request failed

expired.description: Left out when there is no readable Expires date

fields.description: RFC 9116 fields, cleaned and shortened; left out when no file was found

effort.description: How much work the fix is

severity.description: critical, high, medium and low lower the score. harden is optional hardening and never counts. pass is a check that passed.

notes.description: Checks that did not finish, were skipped or saw partial data

signed.description: True when the file carries an OpenPGP cleartext signature

url.description: Where the file was found; left out when none was found

title: Check security.txt
